steps.note: The whey is brought to pH 4.6 with hydrochloric acid; without it, at the whey's own pH of about 6.5, the purity is far lower.

steps.name: pressurise
steps.note: The whey is held at 600 MPa, which makes the beta-lactoglobulin clump and fall out, while the alpha-lactalbumin, the one wanted, stays dissolved.

processing.text: These are the conditions of one pilot-scale study, which reached 46 % yield and 80 % purity of alpha-lactalbumin in the clear liquid; commercial routes may differ.

links.name: Romo et al., Foods 2023: Separation of alpha-Lactalbumin Enriched Fraction from Bovine Native Whey Concentrate

sources.text: The steps, pressure, pH and yields are from this study, which separates the fraction from native whey concentrate.
